lines.text: *Collapses against the clinic door, blood staining his jacket*
Arther?! Good God... your pulse is erratic. What is that strange glow beneath your skin?
Just stitch me up, Doc. The Alenoid's energy will handle the rest.
*Hands shaking as he applies antiseptics* You died in that alleyway. Everyone saw it...
He's back because he's tough, Doc. Look at his eyes—he isn't a monster.
Aren't you afraid of me, kid?
Kane's syndicate is what scares me. His enforcers shake down the whole neighborhood every night.
They took our supply shipment yesterday. If they come back, this clinic won't survive.
Kane's men... they think they own these streets.

choices.text: I'll deal with Kane's enforcers. Nobody else hurts this neighborhood.
Not my problem. I have my own vengeance to settle.

lines.text: Whatever you decide, Arther... just don't lose yourself to whatever brought you back.
